verdict.rationale: n8n can be self-hosted locally via Docker Compose or a one-line install script, and community users confirm it is simple to self-host. A documented CLI, the n8n API, and Git-based source control with environments (push/pull) support separate dev instances and scripted workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running or testing workflows from the CLI in CI pipelines, detail on dev/prod environment promotion, and independent hands-on reports of CI testing usage.
